scope: Independent bounded static/offline interface review. Reviewer executed no native capability call, partition, VM, guest, debugger or probe. The parent-produced capability receipt is reviewed as existing evidence.
summary: The installed x64 WHV_REGISTER_NAME has no DebugCtl, LBR, LER or RTIT/PT register enumerants. This is an interface limitation, not proof that CPU hardware lacks tracing.

TLFS HV_REGISTER_NAME and WHP WHV_REGISTER_NAME are distinct namespaces and call contracts. Directly passing 0x8007d, 0x82002 or 0x82100 to WHvGetVirtualProcessorRegisters is not documented. Guessing 0x207d from neighboring mappings is equally unsupported.

A documented PMU/LBR feature query exists, but the current DLL returned WHV_E_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY, zero bytes written and untouched requested buffer. Capability is unknown, not false; current evidence does not justify starting an LBR acquisition experiment.

perfmon.meaning: Supported feature exposure; not a host register-read API or branch-history buffer.

nested_debugctl.meaning: A synthetic processor feature indicates nonzero DEBUG_CTL writes for nested context; it is not a WHV_REGISTER_NAME or evidence of an accessible current-VP history.

state_getter.limit: No dedicated LBR/LER/PT trace-buffer state category. Generic XSAVE existence alone does not establish that this partition saves an architectural LBR/PT component; component capability, enabled state, layout and valid captured bytes would need independent evidence. NestedState is not a license to parse undocumented outer VMCS data.

primary_sources.supports: WHP signature requires WHV_REGISTER_NAME and a partition HANDLE; success is S_OK.
Public WHP x64 register enum and values; no matching DebugCtl/LBR names found in the reviewed page.
TLFS separately lists DebugCtl=0x8007d, LerFromLip=0x82002, LerToLip=0x82003, LbrFrom0=0x82100, LbrTo0=0x82200 and RTIT registers starting at0x81008. These names are not WHP enumerants.

TLFS hypercall0x0050 takes HV_PARTITION_ID, HV_VP_INDEX, VTL and HV_REGISTER_NAME. Requires parent partition or self with AccessVpRegisters. A user-mode WHP partition HANDLE does not satisfy that contract by casting.
Processor-related partition features are configured before WHvSetupPartition; property0x100e is ProcessorPerfmonFeatures.
Public saved-state categories and buffer rules; no dedicated branch-history state type.

existing_capability_evidence.extra_byte_explanation: ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes64) allocates a trailing NUL; only64 bytes were supplied to WHvGetCapability. The65th recorded byte is allocation terminator, not returned capability data.
existing_capability_evidence.source_review: One documented WHvGetCapability call; success requires HRESULT0 and exactly8 returned bytes. Failure leaves both feature values null. Reviewer verified receipt SDK/DLL identities against current disk; no rerun.
existing_capability_evidence.interpretation: The runtime does not recognize this capability request. This does not identify whether the limitation is DLL/OS/hypervisor version or underlying CPU support; no hardware no-LBR conclusion follows.

next_executable_conditions: Do not probe guessed TLFS or fabricated WHV register IDs. First establish a documented, version-compatible interface that returns a valid capability response or explicitly documented alternative trace facility. No capability retry is justified without an interface/environment change or a concrete diagnosed calling error.

Only after capability succeeds, identify supported per-VP configuration and retrieval semantics, including CPU model, trace format, enabled scope, buffer ownership, event recording/filtering, overflow/loss and stop/freeze behavior. A feature bit alone does not produce a predecessor.

A guest RDMSR/WRMSR collection microfixture, if later supported and separately authorized, is an instrumented capability experiment: additional guest instructions can change last-branch history and do not supply untouched original-program state. No guest injection into the original program is proposed.

A privileged TLFS path would require its own supported access mechanism and partition/VTL rights, not a WHP enum cast. No driver, kernel component, environment download or VM is introduced by this review.

Any later successful acquisition must distinguish RET from intervening #DB/IRETD, prove records belong to the stopped VP and exact interval, and detect missing/overwritten events. Unknown sources stay rejected; no automatic RF clear.
not_proved: No actual predecessor or event history was acquired.
No LBR/PT configuration or tracing was started.
No current host getter for LBR/LER/PT was demonstrated.
No transparent RF reconstruction, full canonical57 state, Windows/WOW64 or original-game acceptance.
retention: One small JSON report only; no copied SDK, executable, memory capture or downloaded environment. Existing frozen evidence remains unchanged.
